# 2 Clement — Chapter 8 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 8
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. While we are on earth, let us repent. For we are clay in the craftsman's hand.
2. For just as the potter, if he is making a vessel and it bends or breaks in his hands, reshapes it again, but if he has already thrown it into the fire of the kiln, he can no longer repair it — so also we, while we are in this world, let us repent from our whole heart of the evil things we have done in the flesh, so that we may be saved by the Lord while we have time for repentance.
3. For after we have departed from the world, we are no longer able to confess there or to repent.
4. So, brothers, if we do the will of the Father and keep the flesh pure and observe the commandments of the Lord, we shall receive eternal life.
5. For the Lord says in the Gospel: "If you did not guard the small thing, who will give you the great? For I say to you, the one who is faithful in a very little is also faithful in much."
6. So then this is what he means: Keep the flesh pure and the seal unstained, so that we may receive eternal life.
